answer: Every identity locks a $60 bond, a jade seal fading as the bond decays 5% each epoch. Top it up to stay active; a lapsed bond kills the identity and wipes its history. The decay ripples through all identities alike, so no farm can hide its copies. A prism audit refracts a bond's funding trail, exposing clusters paid from one wallet. Forging 1,000 identities costs $60,000 plus $3,000 per epoch; an honest agent pays $60 once and earns it back.
